title: Aura3.0
tagline: our AI-powered mental health companion. Aura listens, understands, and supports you 24/7 with smart insights, secure conversations, and evidence-based guidance.
description:
Aura3.0 is a revolutionary mental health platform that represents the convergence of advanced artificial intelligence, blockchain technology, and decentralized infrastructure to deliver accessible, secure, and personalized therapeutic support. At its core, the platform leverages autonomous AI agents powered by sophisticated language models and frameworks like Base's AgentKit and Eliza to provide round-the-clock mental health support, capable of real-time emotion analysis, crisis detection, and personalized therapeutic interventions.

The platform's foundation is built on robust security measures, utilizing Base (Ethereum L2) blockchain technology to ensure transparent and secure session management. This blockchain integration enables smart contract-based consent management, creating immutable session records and facilitating transparent payment processing, including cryptocurrency options. The system maintains the highest standards of privacy and security through end-to-end encryption, zero-knowledge proofs, and strict adherence to HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 compliance requirements.

What sets Aura3.0 apart is its innovative integration with smart environments and IoT technology. The platform synchronizes with various IoT devices and wearables to create optimal therapeutic environments, monitor real-time biometric data, and automatically adjust ambient conditions based on the user's emotional and physical state. This creates a holistic therapeutic experience that extends beyond traditional digital interactions.

The technical architecture is built on modern, scalable technologies, with a frontend powered by Next.js 14 and React 18 using TypeScript, featuring a sleek user interface built with shadcn/ui components. The backend infrastructure employs Node.js microservices, PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, and WebSocket for real-time communications. This robust technical foundation ensures smooth, responsive user experiences while maintaining the highest standards of security and performance.

Looking toward the future, Aura3.0 has an ambitious roadmap that includes multi-language support, advanced AI model integration, mobile app development, and expanded healthcare provider features. The platform aims to revolutionize mental healthcare delivery by reducing barriers to access, providing cost-effective solutions, and enabling data-driven improvements in treatment outcomes. Through its comprehensive approach to mental health support, Aura3.0 represents a significant step forward in democratizing access to quality mental healthcare while maintaining the highest standards of privacy, security, and therapeutic efficacy.
how_its_made:
Aura3.0 is built using a modern tech stack centered around Next.js 14 and React 18, with TypeScript providing type safety throughout the application. The project leverages several key partner technologies, particularly Coinbase's developer platform tools, to create a sophisticated mental health support system.

The core AI therapeutic functionality is implemented using @coinbase/agentkit and @coinbase/agentkit-langchain, which provide the foundation for the autonomous agent system. The therapy agent is built using LangChain and OpenAI's GPT-4 model, with a sophisticated architecture that handles everything from session management to crisis detection. The agent system is designed with a singleton pattern to ensure consistent state management across the application.

For the blockchain integration, the platform utilizes Base (Ethereum L2) through ethers.js, with smart contracts managed using Hardhat. The project incorporates Privy for authentication (@privy-io/react-auth and @privy-io/server-auth), providing secure user management. Data storage is handled through a PostgreSQL database with Drizzle ORM (@neondatabase/serverless and drizzle-orm) for efficient data operations.

The frontend is built with a modern UI stack including shadcn/ui components (various @radix-ui components), TailwindCSS for styling, and Framer Motion for animations. Real-time communication is implemented using WebSocket technology (next-ws), enabling immediate responses between the AI agents and users. The application also integrates with various AWS services (@aws-sdk) for additional backend functionality, including API Gateway and SNS for notifications.

A notable technical innovation is the integration of Lit Protocol (@elizaos/plugin-lit and @lit-protocol/lit-node-client) for decentralized access control and encryption, ensuring HIPAA-compliant data protection. The therapy agent implements sophisticated session monitoring and emergency response systems, with real-time event handling for crisis situations.

The project uses several specialized tools for enhanced functionality, including @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for 3D visualizations, recharts for data visualization, and various React hooks and utilities for state management (zustand) and form handling (react-hook-form). The development environment is supported by a comprehensive set of development tools including TypeScript, ESLint, and Hardhat's development suite for smart contract development.
This architecture enables the platform to provide secure, real-time therapeutic support while maintaining high standards of data privacy and user security, all while leveraging the benefits of blockchain technology for transparent session management and secure payment processing.
